The '''Bakura Imperial Repair Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. The station had repair docks capable of handling three [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] up to two hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, as well as a single dock that could hold thirty [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The station was armed with eight [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. During the [[Bakura Incident]], its staff repaired [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] ships.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> During the [[Battle of Bakura]], the repair station was responsible for repairing damaged [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]].
